messages:
nina: Kicking off routing-v2 gradual rollout (canary 20%) across prod. Starting EU smoke + prefills. Will monitor p95, kv_prefill miss, and synth fanout.

deploy-bot: [deploy] routing-v2 rollout initiated at 2026-03-24T09:00Z. Canary=20% (EU first). Logs+metrics -> /deploys/4970001110.

ben: Synth in eu-west1 shows early tail after ~90s: p95 320ms (baseline ~80ms), synth 429s 0.04%. kv_prefill miss_rate 0.10. Traces point to embed shim call path.

nina: Running quick health probe on a canary host:
``
GET /_health -> {"lat_ms":320,"kv_prefill_miss":0.10,"embed_shim_errors":0.01}
``

sre-alerts: Alert: eu-west1 synth-p95 >300ms threshold breached at 4970001134. Paging oncall.

ben: I suspect prefill key namespace changed in routing-v2; warmup keys not recognized so prefill misses cascade. Recommend immediate regional pin to routing-v1 and pause global ramp.

opsbot: Dry-run pin proposed: eu-west1 20% -> routing-v1. Use `/ops pin promote 4970001110 eu-west1` to apply.

nina: Approving immediate pin for EU and halting other regions. Execute promote now.
deploy-bot: Pin promotion executed at 4970001142. eu-west1 traffic routed to routing-v1 (100%). Remaining rollouts paused.

ben: Post-pin synth snapshot T+45s: p95 back to 85ms, kv_prefill miss_rate 0.02, 429s resolved. Good rollback signal.

nina: Opening INF-512 to track root cause: prefill namespace mismatch + missing migration. Adding eng-runtime and eng-ml. Also adding item to canary checklist: pre-warm sample keys and assert miss_rate <0.05 before ramp.

sre-alerts: Incident closed: synth-p95 returned to baseline.

nina: Updating release notes: routing-v2 rollout paused for investigation; EU briefly pinned back to routing-v1 due to KV prefill regression impacting tail latency. Will reopen when INF-512 resolved and verification passes.

ben: I'll own INF-512. Plan: reproduce in staging with sample keys, run worker backlog sim, validate TTL and key-format, add automated canary gate.

nina: Thanks. Closing thread for now. Keep INF-512 updates in the incident tracker and reopen deploy thread for rerun once fixed.
